title: The Offer
brief: Big Bar's man wants a word, at the top of an unfinished tower in Eko Crest. He has brought a rifle. It is not for him.
standout: One rifle, one target, three ways it can go.

say.speaker: Eko Crest
lines: Big Bar's man: The Chief admires a boy who takes what he wants.
Big Bar's man: He has a job for that boy. Come up. Mind the edge.

objectives.title: THE OFFER
lines: Zainab Yusuf-Cole is crossing the plaza below. The rifle is on its stand.
Big Bar's man: One shot, and you are a rich man with no enemies.

options.text: Fake it: miss, and get her out
Turn the rifle on Big Bar's men

sayDone.speaker: The plaza
lines: The story Zainab was chasing is buried with her.
Big Bar's man: Welcome to the family.

objectives.text: Get Zainab out of the plaza
objectives.sub: Before they see she is breathing

objectives.text: Fight your way off the tower
objectives.sub: Three of Big Bar's men. One has a gun.
